final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark FROM orderexecutions), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(p.avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark f WHERE p.avg_unfilled > f.benchmark) SELECT AVG(p.avg_unfilled) AS average_unfilled, AVG(p.avg_unfilled - f.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_first, AVG(p.avg_unfilled - s.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_second FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark s WHERE p.avg_unfilled > f.benchmark AND p.avg_unfilled > s.benchmark
